MonolithNote.title: MonolithNote
MonolithNote.description: A user-authored 3D annotation pinned to a specific landmark or coordinate on the desert monolith.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns this monolith note.

title.description: Short label or heading for the pinned monolith part.

body.description: Detailed note text attached to the monolith coordinate.

partName.description: Detected or user-specified structural part name on the monolith.

color.description: Visual beacon color for the 3D pin marker.

posX.description: 3D world X coordinate of the pinned point on the monolith.

posY.description: 3D world Y coordinate of the pinned point on the monolith.

posZ.description: 3D world Z coordinate of the pinned point on the monolith.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was last modified.

/monolith_notes/{noteId}.description: User-owned 3D notes pinned to specific parts of the desert monolith.
